attempt_accounting.asr_call_definition: One native family audio-decode invocation for one newly generated, byte-frozen cell.
attempt_accounting.consumed_boundary: Exclusive started file plus file and containing-directory fsync before each call; failed/timeout/crashed started slots remain consumed.
attempt_accounting.denominator_policy: Retain every six-cell and eighteen-slot row, including failures, not_run, disagreements and exclusions, stratified by voice and text condition.
attempt_accounting.failure_policy: Stop on any failed call, timeout, resource violation or TTS output/token/duration limit; retain failed and unstarted slots. Never refill, rename or resume.
attempt_accounting.global_once_boundary: Distinct fixed create-event refs for TTS and ASR, run_attempt=1, source-bound one-use release, and verified prior-claim history. Local exclusive files alone do not prevent new-workspace replay.
attempt_accounting.tts_call_definition: One top-level generate_custom_voice call for one cell. Its ordinary autoregressive subtalker work is internal, never another top-level request.

derivation.sole_behavior_change: Exact all-zero final PCM16 bytes add derived_pcm_silent; quarantine as not_run_quality before ASR. No amplitude/SNR threshold, retry, changed generation or changed denominator.

publication.data_read_path: Read the one complete data-result ZIP as raw-content chunks and manifest at one verified immutable kws-data commit. Compressed archive <=12MiB plus manifest <=16KiB; <=16MiB reserved total data response bodies. No unaccounted base64/API download path. The derived WAV payload (<2.31MB) is consumed-audio size, not download size.
publication.output_rights_scope: research/development; commercial output rights not established
publication.transport: TTS runs in kws-data and publishes WAVs only to same-repository create-only audio refs with its scoped GITHUB_TOKEN. Pipeline ASR reads the fixed verified data commit and publishes audio-free machine evidence to pipeline create-only refs; no Actions artifacts or WAV-bearing pipeline/log transport.
publication.tts_audio_derivation: Each cell has one native 24k mono float32 source and one fixed 2:3 scipy-resample-poly 16k mono PCM16 derivative. Bind original float values, raw WAV, derived WAV, PCM and frame geometry in the same cell receipt; no additional synthesis, gain or trimming.
publication.tts_output_members: Six derived PCM WAVs, six native FLOAT WAVs, and bounded allowlisted source/generation/EOS/resource JSON receipts, only in kws-data.

quality_policy.asr_disposition: not_run_quality unless an already-fixed duplicate quarantine also applies
quality_policy.derived_pcm_silent_definition: All final decoded PCM16 sample bytes are zero; compute after WAV write/readback and independently recompute from published WAV. Any nonzero int16 sample, including +1 or -1, is not silent under this rule.
quality_policy.generation_status: Natural generation may remain complete; quality exclusion is an independent pre-ASR disposition.

caveats: RSS/disk thresholds are sampled, not hard continuous limits.
TTS RLIMIT_CPU is per process, not aggregate process-tree CPU.
Transport input body caps are not all-wire traffic caps.
Weight cache is not established. No download, installation or runtime check has run.
Model/native-I/O preflight may use fixed synthetic numeric samples but no model construction or audio generation.
resources.provider: public GitHub standard ubuntu-24.04 hosted runner or separately reviewed already-owned resource

scientific_limits.agreement: All three successful, fully native/source/config-bound outputs must normalize identically and nonempty; no majority voting.
scientific_limits.normalization: Existing fixed punctuation/whitespace removal only; no homophone, script, case or Unicode folding.

stage_barrier: All six fixed TTS cells must finish once without failure/cap; no early ASR. Successful cells with signal-quality flags are quarantined before ASR.
Verify genuine claims, complete runtime/source/model custody, 24k float source and 16k mono PCM16 derivative bytes, PCM/frames and EOS termination.

Before ASR, quarantine every member of each same-batch equal-WAV or equal-PCM group symmetrically; quarantine any cell overlapping frozen historical consumed/selection WAV or PCM identities. Preserve all six TTS outcomes and all eighteen slots with not_run_duplicate or not_run_quality reasons; never reuse old transcripts or regenerate.

Freeze all six actual WAV/PCM/frame identities, history-comparison inventory, deterministic quarantine decisions and fresh eligible-only blind job/source inventory before releasing any ASR. Each eligible unique new cell permits exactly three new slots; maximum eighteen. No eligible cells means no ASR release.
Native policies, decode configurations, retained source closure, resource scope and worst-case evidence packaging must be frozen before audio-forward.
TTS and ASR releases are independently reviewed; successful TTS does not automatically release ASR.

tts.seed_policy: One predeclared seed per voice, paired across the two texts; no seed search.
